name: w05-harness-selftest
description: Proves the acceptance harness itself behaves truthfully: evidence-class ladder, redaction, SHA-256 index, production guard and command receipt capture.

entries.name: Evidence-class ladder blocks weak evidence
entries.claim: Unit evidence can never satisfy external or desktop requirements.

entries.name: Secrets are redacted before storage
entries.claim: Passwords, tokens, JWTs, private keys and URL credentials never reach receipts.

entries.name: SHA-256 index verifies clean files and detects tampering
entries.claim: Evidence artifacts are content-addressed and tamper-evident.

entries.name: Production deny guard rejects production endpoints
entries.claim: Production endpoints are always rejected; only local or reserved disposable targets pass.

entries.name: Command receipt capture on the local runtime
entries.claim: A real local process is executed and captured as a redacted command receipt.
